description: Found while building fz-sc8.72. `case m do Foo -> :yes; _ -> :no end` is refused with "module aliases are not valid patterns". In Elixir an alias in a pattern is the atom Elixir.Foo and matches by equality, like any atom literal. Since fz-sc8.72 the decoder produces Expr::Alias(ModuleName) and World::module_alias_atom answers which atom it is; the pattern reader (src/dispatch_matrix/pattern.rs) should turn an alias into the same constant-atom test it already builds for an atom literal, through the same authority guards use. Oracle fixtures for case, function heads and =. Deviation from Elixir; not needed by the distiller.
title: A module alias in a pattern matches that module's atom
